blurb: Tropical cyclone genesis, heat-engine thermodynamics, vortex dynamics, storm surge, forecasting, climate and risk.

pics.alt: World map with thousands of tropical cyclone tracks drawn as coloured dotted lines across the tropical oceans
pics.caption: Tracks of all tropical cyclones worldwide from 1985 to 2005, plotted at six-hourly positions and coloured by Saffir–Simpson intensity. The western North Pacific is the most active basin, and the South Atlantic and south-east Pacific are almost empty.
pics.title: Global tropical cyclone tracks-edit2.jpg

pics.alt: Cut-away diagram of a Northern Hemisphere tropical cyclone showing the eye, eyewall, rainbands, rising and sinking air, and the outflow cirrus shield
pics.caption: Schematic cut-away of a Northern Hemisphere tropical cyclone. Air spirals inward and rises in the eyewall and rainbands, flows out beneath the cirrus shield at upper levels, and sinks in the eye.
